description: Convoy Under Fire: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: {client} has six freighters crossing {system} with fuel and munitions for the front. {enemy} knows the route. Escort them to the exit gate. The raiders will come first. After that, expect a frigate.
A convoy carrying supplies for {client} must reach the far gate of {system}. It has little protection of its own. You are the protection. Get them through.
Convoy is under your care. {enemy} raiders will try to pick off the freighters before they reach the exit. Do not let them.
success: The last freighter jumps and the exit gate flares. {client} pays {captain} and the freighters' masters add a tip.
The convoy is through. {client} pays and asks whether you can do it again next week.
Freighters delivered, mostly. {client} will use the word acceptable in its report.
failure: Too many freighters are wreckage. {client} writes off the cargo and your fee.
The convoy never reaches the gate. {client} will find another escort.
radio-convoy: Convoy to escort. Six ships, one gate, nobody wants to be late.
Convoy Master here. We are heading for the gate. Do not leave us.
This is the convoy. We are slow. We know. Please guard us anyway.
radio-raiders: Raiders ahead. Six fighters and two gunships on the freighters.
Contacts in front. They will go for the slow ones first.
{enemy} raiders closing. Break them up before they reach the convoy.
radio-frigate: Frigate behind us! It was waiting beyond the debris. Convoy, hard to port.
Heavy contact, rear. A frigate and fighters. It is going to gut the freighters.
Convoy Master to escort: there is a frigate on our tail. Please do something about it.
radio-rescue: Friendly gunships on approach. {client} heard the trouble. They can cover the gate.
Support wing in. Convoy, keep moving.
